text:
You need help setting up Tableau best practices and troubleshooting current reports and dashboards.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. In a recent Sales KPI dashboard project for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports, which consolidated reporting and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours.

I can help review your Tableau setup, tighten report structure, and troubleshoot dashboard issues with a practical, data-focused approach. I’m comfortable working through data modeling, report logic, and visualization quality to support best practices.

What Tableau issues are you seeing most often right now: data source setup, workbook structure, or dashboard performance?
